title: Fix untrappable JSON error in E-Document ADI import (Bug 640122)
summary: E-Document matching assistance import now handles malformed Azure Document Intelligence responses gracefully by checking JSON property existence and adding telemetry for diagnostic purposes instead of crashing with an untrappable error.
key_points: Every JSON property read in E-Document matching assistance now validates the Get call return value
Missing or malformed ADI response properties no longer cause untrappable runtime errors
Telemetry warnings added to diagnose which property is missing from ADI responses
Import degrades gracefully when Azure response structure is incomplete
Helper functions return empty objects instead of dereferencing uninitialized tokens
